Video

My opening statement on tonight’s Life, Liberty & Levin

foxnews.com/video/6392586286…
See you soon - 8 PM eastern on Life, Liberty & Levin on Fox! If you can’t watch live you can DVR the show. Don’t miss it!

Sick


Sid Rosenberg (@sidrosenberg19)

So columnist @LeonardGreene of the @NYDailyNews writes today that the possibility of @realDonaldTrump picking 2 more Supreme Court judges is SCARIER to him than a 7 month old being shot to death in NYC this week. He also added scarier than an American hero being shot down in Iran. Then you people want to know why sane people like me hate the Democrat party? That goes beyond TDS! As Trump would say these are very sick people! OMG!



— https://nitter.net/si

Newscum is a moron


Brit Hume (@brithume)

They were no longer married when she went to work for Fox News.



— https://nitter.net/brithume/status/2040502701474156894#m

These fools are such a waste of time. People should stop watching these truly stupid and moronic podcasts — with conspiracy nuts, know-nothings, bigots, racists, Christian-haters, Jew-haters, America-haters, weirdos.


William A. Jacobson (@wajacobson)

Quite incredible, the notion that the "staff" should prevail over the president, and that it's somehow illegitimate that he ignored them. Who elected the staff?



— https://nitter.net/wajacobson/status/2040459098781564948#m

Well said


Restoring the West (@RestoringWest)

The Restoring the West Manifesto

I spent the first part of my life living under oppression. I know what it means to be silenced, to have your freedom stolen, to watch a civilization reject the very values that make human flourishing possible.

I also know what it means to be free. And I know that freedom is not inevitable — it must be defended, understood, and taught anew to every generation.

The West is at risk of losing that fight. And too man

Now, it makes perfect sense.


James Lindsay, anti-Communist (@ConceptualJames)

In case you wonder what's up with them, all these idiot Libertarian accounts ("Comic" Dave Smith, Tom Woods, Libertarian Party) are huge devotees of noted Jew-hater Hans-Hermann Hoppe who believed Marx was correct about everything and could be retooled into a Libertarian by reorienting his whole awful program around Austrian economics (which requires and forwards economic liberty, hilariously enough).

Javier Milei,

This is a very dangerous and despicable person. It was only a matter of time that he and his ilk would go there.


Jake Shields (@jakeshieldsajj)

“The only solution is to start killing politicians”



— https://nitter.net/jakeshieldsajj/status/2040417066273087507#m

We should not roll over while the Democrats try and burn down the country. Listen to the Mark Levin Show podcast for free now.

megaphone.link/WWO9299650647

A fantastic Life, Liberty & Levin on Fox tonight at 8 PM Eastern, Sen John Fetterman and Gen Jack Keane. If you can’t watch live set your DVR now! God bless!

Video

Of course. And they want no political accountability for the unaffordable gas prices.  Do they blame capitalism and oil companies?


Bill Melugin (@BillMelugin_)

A six month CBS investigation found no evidence that California’s highest in the nation gas prices are the result of price gouging, as state politicians have repeatedly claimed.

Instead, the investigation found those prices are largely the result of California’s own policies.



— https://nitter.net/BillMelugin_/status/204045852395222

Newscum, the king of high gasoline prices


Rachel Keuler (@rkeuler)

Hahaha. CBS did a 6 month investigation and concluded that high California gas prices are entirely the fault of Gavin Newsom & CA leadership.
“55% of each gallon of gas includes California-specific costs.”



— https://nitter.net/rkeuler/status/2040245712517279954#m

Damn, you’re nuts


Joe Kent (@joekent16jan19)

Trump’s negotiations were working. 

Thats why Israel forced this war by attacking Iran, to sabotage the deal he was about to make. 

Israel needs this war to reach their goals. We need peace to achieve ours. 

Whoever restores order will hold the power. This should be our goal.



— https://nitter.net/joekent16jan19/status/2040418079352438815#m
